{"parentUuid":"d56e0a92-c859-4af7-a756-72d1c37383ae","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"01cb2c3d-c5a2-4062-8fae-e2b29dd04c71","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RhzC5NvsHAv5F5r1PTciPc","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T15:44:20.809Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` passwords set by env, so checks never touch the real `cms.db`.\n- The user has accepted \"not checked\" for Safari and 768/1440 on T15 and T16, recorded on the issue.\n- **Click by element ref, not coordinates**: the screenshot coordinate frame switches between e.g. 1372×872 and 1200×763 within one session, so coordinate clicks miss (T18 typed a description into the body). Use `find` refs.\n- **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. The Editor's own listener sets its \"leaving\" flag, and nothing is posted.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive a server restart; `fetch(src, {cache: \"reload\"})` then navigate again.\n---\nname: design-taste\ndescription: \"User rejects default/\\\"AI-ey\\\" visual design; what was rejected and what was approved for the public site\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: feedback\n  originSessionId: eae09489-d0ef-4a1c-b220-1610b02a6314\n  modified: 2026-10-01T17:17:38.016Z\n---\n\nThe user rejected two mockups before approving one (session 22, 2026-10-01, spec #22):\n- Rejected as \"juvenile and AI-ey\": Inter, purple gradient hero, rounded cards with shadows and coloured top borders, pill nav, uppercase eyebrows everywhere.\n- Rejected as \"everyone uses this\": the newspaper look, meaning a Newsreader-style serif, italic standfirsts, and a masthead nameplate.\n- Approved, \"set like a dataset\": Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono, solid Kenyon-purple fields with a faint plotting grid, one citron accent only on purple, numbered nav and sections, ISO dates, and Reports in a real table. The mockup is in `docs/design/session-22-mockup/`.\n\n**Why:** they want it \"genuinely impressive and out of the box but also readable and a school website\".\n\n**How to apply:** for any visual work here (including the later admin-console redesign), don't start from stock patterns. Pick a concept tied to the office's actual subject and justify the font choice. Build on the approved system, not on defaults. {"parentUuid":"f5390c0c-50cd-420b-b5d5-f3aac982e3a8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"01cb2c3d-c5a2-4062-8fae-e2b29dd04c71","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01KEDAjXTUpxPbqYbLYXjdAz","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings, site_links\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Admin only: the message after a successful save (app.flash). */\n.admin-confirmation { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2e7d32 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #2e7d32; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n/* Charts (app.chart_drawing): an SVG scaled to the column, its text at the\n   size its layout assumes (FONT, in the SVG's units), and its data in a\n   <details> table that scrolls sideways rather than widen the page. Each is\n   drawn twice; the narrow drawing replaces the wide one on a phone, and\n   display: none takes the hidden one out of the accessibility tree. */\n.chart-figure { margin: 1.5rem 0; }\n.chart-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n.chart-svg, .chart-svg-phone { display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }\n.chart-svg-phone { display: none; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .chart-svg { display: none; } .chart-svg-phone { display: block; } }\n.chart-figure text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; }\n.chart-figure polyline { stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }\n.chart-figure circle { stroke: Canvas; }\n.chart-note, .chart-source { margin: 0.25rem 0; }\n.chart-data { margin-top: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n.chart-data summary { cursor: pointer; }\n.content-body .chart-data td { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  .chart-figure text { fill: #c3c2b7; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-tick { fill: #898781; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-grid { stroke: #2c2c2a; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-baseline { stroke: #5c5b57; }\n  .chart-series-1, .chart-marker-1 { fill: #3987e5; } .chart-line-1 { stroke: #3987e5; }\n  .chart-series-2, .chart-marker-2 { fill: #d95926; } .chart-line-2 { stroke: #d95926; }\n  .chart-series-3, .chart-marker-3 { fill: #199e70; } .chart-line-3 { stroke: #199e70; }\n  .chart-series-4, .chart-marker-4 { fill: #c98500; } .chart-line-4 { stroke: #c98500; }\n}\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { background: #fff4ce; border-left: 4px solid #9a6700; color: #4d3800; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Admin only: an edit form's fields beside its Site preview, stacked below\n   them on a narrow screen. */\nbody:has(.admin-site-preview) { max-width: 90rem; }\n.admin-content-fields textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); box-sizing: border-box; display: block; height: 75vh; min-height: 24rem; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame[data-width=\"phone\"] { max-width: 100%; width: 390px; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor (static/editor.js), its toolbar, and the parts of a\n   body it can't edit, shown read-only. */\n.admin-editor-label { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n/* The table controls, shown while the cursor is in a table. Not named\n   \"table\": only .content-body's own rules may style tables (T09). */\n.admin-editor-cell-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-cell-tools[hidden] { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar [aria-pressed=\"true\"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); }\n.admin-editor-link { margin-block: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-link p { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; margin: 0.25rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-link[hidden], .admin-editor-link p[hidden] { display: none; }\n/* A site link that won't be a link on the site, marked for the writer. */\n.admin-editor-area a[data-link-mark]::after { background: #fff4ce; border-radius: 3px; color: #4d3800; content: attr(data-link-mark); display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 0.3em; padding: 0 0.35em; }\n.admin-editor-message, .admin-chart-builder-message { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #b3261e; margin: 0.25rem 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; }\n.admin-editor-message:empty, .admin-chart-builder-message:empty { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-area { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); min-height: 16rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); margin-block: 0.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked-note { font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; margin: 0.4rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-locked pre { overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Admin only: a Chart in the Editor's body, as a card, and the Chart builder\n   (T17). The builder's grid is styled by its own classes: only\n   .content-body's own rules may style tables (T09). */\n.admin-editor-chart { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; margin-block: 0.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-chart-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }\n.admin-chart-builder { box-sizing: border-box; max-height: calc(100vh - 1rem); max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem); padding: 1rem; width: 52rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder::backdrop { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }\n.admin-chart-builder h2 { margin-top: 0; }\n.admin-chart-builder h3 { margin: 1rem 0 0.25rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-fields p { margin: 0.5rem 0; }\n.admin-chart-builder-fields label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-fields input, .admin-chart-builder-fields select { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%; width: 26rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-fields small, .admin-chart-builder-hint { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-hint { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-suggestion { background: #fff4ce; border-left: 4px solid #9a6700; color: #4d3800; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-suggestion[hidden] { display: none; }\n.admin-chart-builder-error { color: #b3261e; display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 0.15rem 0 0; }\n.admin-chart-builder-error:empty { display: none; }\n.admin-chart-builder [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #b3261e; outline: 2px solid #b3261e; outline-offset: -1px; }\n.admin-chart-builder-grid-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }\n.admin-chart-builder-grid { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.admin-chart-builder-cell { padding: 0.15rem; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }\n.admin-chart-builder-cell input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 8.5rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-name { align-items: flex-start; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder-cell .admin-chart-builder-error { max-width: 8.5rem; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .admin-chart-builder-cell input, .admin-chart-builder-cell .admin-chart-builder-error { width: 6.5rem; max-width: 6.5rem; } }\n.admin-chart-builder-grid-tools, .admin-chart-builder-actions { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }\n/* As wide as the public page's column, so the chart is drawn at its size there. */\n.admin-chart-builder-preview { border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); max-width: 40rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor's \"Insert image\" panel (T18), with the item's chart\n   images as thumbnails, and the image in the body it is changing. */\n/* A fieldset is as wide as its widest content unless told otherwise, which\n   would push the page sideways on a phone. */\n.admin-editor-image, .admin-editor-image-choices { min-width: 0; }\n  .admin-content-editing .admin-site-preview { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n    # Where each site link its body may have leads, {site reference: path in\n    # the site}; None for the published items' (published_links).\n    links: Mapping[str, str] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        links = published_links() if self.links is None else self.links\n\n        def link_href(reference: str) -> str | None:\n            path = links.get(reference)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src, link_href=link_href,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef published_links() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Where a site link to each published item leads, {site reference: path\n    in the site}. A draft, deleted, or unknown one is not here, so a link to\n    it is its text.\"\"\"\n    return {**{site_links.reference(\"data-bite\", bite[\"ref\"]): data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"])\n               for bite in data_bites.list_published()},\n            **{site_links.reference(\"report\", found[\"ref\"]): report_path(found[\"slug\"])\n               for found in reports.list_published()}}\n\n\ndef _linked_as_published(page: Page, kind: str, item: Mapping) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A Site preview's page, whose item's own site links resolve as if it\n    were published; a new item has no ref yet.\"\"\"\n    links = published_links()\n    if item.get(\"ref\"):\n        links[site_links.reference(kind, item[\"ref\"])] = page.path\n    return replace(page, links=links)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    bite = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    return _linked_as_published(_data_bite_page(bite), \"data-bite\", bite)\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return _linked_as_published(replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav),\n                                \"report\", report)\n\"\"\"The public site, served at the same paths `cms publish` exports it to. No\nlogin: everything here is published content only (app.public_site).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.public_site import Page\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _html(page: Page | None) -> HTMLResponse:\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return HTMLResponse(page.render())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\")\n@router.get(\"/index.html\")\ndef home():\n    return _html(public_site.home())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef stylesheet():\n    return Response(public_site.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/\")\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/index.html\")\ndef data_bite_list():\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/{slug}.html\")\ndef data_bite(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.data_bite_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/\")\n@router.get(\"/reports/index.html\")\ndef report_list():\n    return _html(public_site.report_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/{slug}.html\")\ndef report(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.report(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/reports/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.report_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/files/{slug}.pdf\")\ndef report_file(slug: str):\n    found = public_site.report_file(slug)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return pdf_response(*found)\n\n\ndef pdf_response(path: Path, name: str | None = None) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A Report's stored file, served as a PDF and never sniffed as anything\n    else; downloaded as `name` if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\", filename=name,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\n\"\"\"A Site preview's own copy of the site, which the Data Bite and Report\nadmin routes serve under their login at /admin/<type>/<id>/preview/ (and\n/admin/<type>/preview/ for a new item). A Site preview's links are relative\nand resolve there (app.public_site.Page.render_preview).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.routes.public import pdf_response, stylesheet\n\n# A path in the site, as the *_path functions of app.public_site make them:\n# never starting with \"/\" or a backslash, so a redirect to \"/\" + it stays on\n# this site.\n_SITE_PATH = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*\", re.ASCII)\n\n\ndef site_file(path: str, images: dict[str, Path], pdfs: dict[str, Path] | None = None) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"What a Site preview's link to `path` in the site gets: the stylesheet,\n    or one of the previewed item's own chart `images` or `pdfs` (a Report's\n    file), by path in the site, which the public site would not serve for a\n    draft. Any other page sends the browser to the published one.\"\"\"\n    if path == \"style.css\":\n        return stylesheet()\n    if path in images:\n        return chart_images.response(images[path])\n    if pdfs and path in pdfs:\n        return pdf_response(pdfs[path])\n    if not _SITE_PATH.fullmatch(path):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/\" + path, status_code=303)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"b8849084-efba-4fb0-be5d-d09fd9185f9f","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:19:28.497Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings, site_links\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Admin only: the message after a successful save (app.flash). */\n.admin-confirmation { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2e7d32 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #2e7d32; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n/* Charts (app.chart_drawing): an SVG scaled to the column, its text at the\n   size its layout assumes (FONT, in the SVG's units), and its data in a\n   <details> table that scrolls sideways rather than widen the page. Each is\n   drawn twice; the narrow drawing replaces the wide one on a phone, and\n   display: none takes the hidden one out of the accessibility tree. */\n.chart-figure { margin: 1.5rem 0; }\n.chart-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n.chart-svg, .chart-svg-phone { display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }\n.chart-svg-phone { display: none; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .chart-svg { display: none; } .chart-svg-phone { display: block; } }\n.chart-figure text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; }\n.chart-figure polyline { stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }\n.chart-figure circle { stroke: Canvas; }\n.chart-note, .chart-source { margin: 0.25rem 0; }\n.chart-data { margin-top: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n.chart-data summary { cursor: pointer; }\n.content-body .chart-data td { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  .chart-figure text { fill: #c3c2b7; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-tick { fill: #898781; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-grid { stroke: #2c2c2a; }\n  .chart-figure .chart-baseline { stroke: #5c5b57; }\n  .chart-series-1, .chart-marker-1 { fill: #3987e5; } .chart-line-1 { stroke: #3987e5; }\n  .chart-series-2, .chart-marker-2 { fill: #d95926; } .chart-line-2 { stroke: #d95926; }\n  .chart-series-3, .chart-marker-3 { fill: #199e70; } .chart-line-3 { stroke: #199e70; }\n  .chart-series-4, .chart-marker-4 { fill: #c98500; } .chart-line-4 { stroke: #c98500; }\n}\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { background: #fff4ce; border-left: 4px solid #9a6700; color: #4d3800; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Admin only: an edit form's fields beside its Site preview, stacked below\n   them on a narrow screen. */\nbody:has(.admin-site-preview) { max-width: 90rem; }\n.admin-content-fields textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); box-sizing: border-box; display: block; height: 75vh; min-height: 24rem; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame[data-width=\"phone\"] { max-width: 100%; width: 390px; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor (static/editor.js), its toolbar, and the parts of a\n   body it can't edit, shown read-only. */\n.admin-editor-label { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n/* The table controls, shown while the cursor is in a table. Not named\n   \"table\": only .content-body's own rules may style tables (T09). */\n.admin-editor-cell-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-cell-tools[hidden] { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar [aria-pressed=\"true\"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); }\n.admin-editor-link { margin-block: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-link p { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; margin: 0.25rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-link[hidden], .admin-editor-link p[hidden] { display: none; }\n/* A site link that won't be a link on the site, marked for the writer. */\n.admin-editor-area a[data-link-mark]::after { background: #fff4ce; border-radius: 3px; color: #4d3800; content: attr(data-link-mark); display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 0.3em; padding: 0 0.35em; }\n.admin-editor-message, .admin-chart-builder-message { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #b3261e; margin: 0.25rem 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; }\n.admin-editor-message:empty, .admin-chart-builder-message:empty { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-area { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); min-height: 16rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); margin-block: 0.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked-note { font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; margin: 0.4rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-locked pre { overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Admin only: a Chart in the Editor's body, as a card, and the Chart builder\n   (T17). max-height: calc(100vh - 1rem); max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem); padding: 1rem; width: 52rem; }\n.admin-chart-builder::backdrop { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }\n.admin-chart-builder h2 { margin-top: 0; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .admin-chart-builder-cell input, .admin-chart-builder-cell .admin-chart-builder-error { width: 6.5rem; max-width: 6.5rem; } }\n.admin-chart-builder-grid-tools, .admin-chart-builder-actions { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }\n/* As wide as the public page's column, so the chart is drawn at its size there. */\n.admin-chart-builder-preview { border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); max-width: 40rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor's \"Insert image\" panel (T18), with the item's chart\n   images as thumbnails, and the image in the body it is changing. */\n/* A fieldset is as wide as its widest content unless told otherwise, which\n   would push the page sideways on a phone. */\n.admin-editor-image, .admin-editor-image-choices { min-width: 0; outline-offset: 2px; }\n.admin-chart-builder-stale figure { opacity: 0.35; }\n@media (min-width: 64rem) {\n  .admin-content-editing { align-items: start; display: grid; gap: 0 2rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .admin-content-editing .admin-site-preview { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n    # Where each site link its body may have leads, {site reference: path in\n    # the site}; None for the published items' (published_links).\n    links: Mapping[str, str] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        links = published_links() if self.links is None else self.links\n\n        def link_href(reference: str) -> str | None:\n            path = links.get(reference)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src, link_href=link_href,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef published_links() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Where a site link to each published item leads, {site reference: path\n    in the site}. A draft, deleted, or unknown one is not here, so a link to\n    it is its text.\"\"\"\n    return {**{site_links.reference(\"data-bite\", bite[\"ref\"]): data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"])\n               for bite in data_bites.list_published()},\n            **{site_links.reference(\"report\", found[\"ref\"]): report_path(found[\"slug\"])\n               for found in reports.list_published()}}\n\n\ndef _linked_as_published(page: Page, kind: str, item: Mapping) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A Site preview's page, whose item's own site links resolve as if it\n    were published; a new item has no ref yet.\"\"\"\n    links = published_links()\n    if item.get(\"ref\"):\n        links[site_links.reference(kind, item[\"ref\"])] = page.path\n    return replace(page, links=links)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    bite = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    return _linked_as_published(_data_bite_page(bite), \"data-bite\", bite)\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return _linked_as_published(replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav),\n                                \"report\", report)\n\"\"\"The public site, served at the same paths `cms publish` exports it to. No\nlogin: everything here is published content only (app.public_site).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.public_site import Page\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _html(page: Page | None) -> HTMLResponse:\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return HTMLResponse(page.render())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\")\n@router.get(\"/index.html\")\ndef home():\n    return _html(public_site.home())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef stylesheet():\n    return Response(public_site.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/\")\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/index.html\")\ndef data_bite_list():\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/{slug}.html\")\ndef data_bite(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.data_bite_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/\")\n@router.get(\"/reports/index.html\")\ndef report_list():\n    return _html(public_site.report_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/{slug}.html\")\ndef report(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.report(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/reports/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.report_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/files/{slug}.pdf\")\ndef report_file(slug: str):\n    found = public_site.report_file(slug)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return pdf_response(*found)\n\n\ndef pdf_response(path: Path, name: str | None = None) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A Report's stored file, served as a PDF and never sniffed as anything\n    else; downloaded as `name` if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\", filename=name,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\n\"\"\"A Site preview's own copy of the site, which the Data Bite and Report\nadmin routes serve under their login at /admin/<type>/<id>/preview/ (and\n/admin/<type>/preview/ for a new item). A Site preview's links are relative\nand resolve there (app.public_site.Page.render_preview).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.routes.public import pdf_response, stylesheet\n\n# A path in the site, as the *_path functions of app.public_site make them:\n# never starting with \"/\" or a backslash, so a redirect to \"/\" + it stays on\n# this site.\n_SITE_PATH = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*\", re.ASCII)\n\n\ndef site_file(path: str, images: dict[str, Path], pdfs: dict[str, Path] | None = None) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"What a Site preview's link to `path` in the site gets: the stylesheet,\n    or one of the previewed item's own chart `images` or `pdfs` (a Report's\n    file), by path in the site, which the public site would not serve for a\n    draft. Any other page sends the browser to the published one.\"\"\"\n    if path == \"style.css\":\n        return stylesheet()\n    if path in images:\n        return chart_images.response(images[path])\n    if pdfs and path in pdfs:\n        return pdf_response(pdfs[path])\n    if not _SITE_PATH.fullmatch(path):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/\" + path, status_code=303)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"a44e6760-e821-4fb4-96f7-6ac4af93a42c","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":2},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f5390c0c-50cd-420b-b5d5-f3aac982e3a8","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

A\n   Site preview (`preview_base`, app.public_site.Page.render_preview) adds a\n   <base> and its banner, and nothing else. #}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import report_list with context %}\n{% block head %}{% if preview_base %}\n  <base href=\"{{ preview_base }}\">{% endif %}{% endblock %}\n{% block title %}{% if page_title %}{{ page_title }} · {% endif %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}\n{% block banner %}{% if preview_base %}\n  <p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">Draft preview, not published</p>{% endif %}{% endblock %}\n{% block nav %}\n  {% if nav_reports %}\n    <nav class=\"nav-site\" aria-label=\"Reports\">{{ report_list(nav_reports) }}</nav>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/report.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article>\n    <h1>{{ report.title }}</h1>\n    {% if has_file %}\n      <p class=\"report-download\"><a href=\"{{ root }}{{ report_file_path(report.slug) }}\" download=\"{{ report.file_name }}\">Download {{ report.file_name }}</a> (PDF)</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <div class=\"content-body\">{{ report.body | markdown(image_src, link_href) }}</div><!-- /content-body -->\n  </article>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ root }}reports/index.html\">All Reports</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/reports.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import report_list with context %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Reports</h1>\n  {% if reports %}\n    {{ report_list(reports) }}\n  {% else %}\n    <p>No Reports published yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        // The title, the body's textarea, or the Editor (static/editor.js).\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)\n            && !event.target.closest(\".admin-editor-area\")) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\", \"body_html\", \"body_dirty\"]) {\n            const field = form.elements[name];\n            if (field && !field.disabled) data.append(name, field.value);\n          }\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n=== templates/login.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Log in</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/login\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p><label>Email <input type=\"email\" name=\"email\" required autocomplete=\"username\"></label></p>\n    <p><label>Password <input type=\"password\" name=\"password\" required autocomplete=\"current-password\"></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Log in</button></p>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"1481715f-8a03-4b23-9a6e-59fb50f5eb23","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:19:28.610Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"=== templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- block head %}{% endblock %}\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path or path_for('stylesheet') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  {%- block banner %}{% endblock %}\n  <header><a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a>{% block nav %}{% endblock %}</header>\n  <main>\n    {%- if user is defined and user %}{% set message = confirmation() %}\n    {%- if message %}<p class=\"admin-confirmation\" role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>{% endif %}{% endif %}\n    {%- block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/public/_lists.html\n{# Pieces the public pages share. A\n   Site preview (`preview_base`, app.public_site.Page.render_preview) adds a\n   <base> and its banner, and nothing else. #}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import report_list with context %}\n{% block head %}{% if preview_base %}\n  <base href=\"{{ preview_base }}\">{% endif %}{% endblock %}\n{% block title %}{% if page_title %}{{ page_title }} · {% endif %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}\n{% block banner %}{% if preview_base %}\n  <p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">Draft preview, not published</p>{% endif %}{% endblock %}\n{% block nav %}\n  {% if nav_reports %}\n    <nav class=\"nav-site\" aria-label=\"Reports\">{{ report_list(nav_reports) }}</nav>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/report.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article>\n    <h1>{{ report.title }}</h1>\n    {% if has_file %}\n      <p class=\"report-download\"><a href=\"{{ root }}{{ report_file_path(report.slug) }}\" download=\"{{ report.file_name }}\">Download {{ report.file_name }}</a> (PDF)</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <div class=\"content-body\">{{ report.body | markdown(image_src, link_href) }}</div><!-- /content-body -->\n  </article>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ root }}reports/index.html\">All Reports</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/reports.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import report_list with context %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Reports</h1>\n  {% if reports %}\n    {{ report_list(reports) }}\n  {% else %}\n    <p>No Reports published yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        // The title, the body's textarea, or the Editor (static/editor.js).\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)\n            && !event.target.closest(\".admin-editor-area\")) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\", \"body_html\", \"body_dirty\"]) {\n            const field = form.elements[name];\n            if (field && !field.disabled) data.append(name, field.value);\n          }\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n=== templates/login.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Log in</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/login\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p><label>Email <input type=\"email\" name=\"email\" required autocomplete=\"username\"></label></p>\n    <p><label>Password <input type=\"password\" name=\"password\" required autocomplete=\"current-password\"></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Log in</button></p>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"a44e6760-e821-4fb4-96f7-6ac4af93a42c","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":2},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f2245e93-56e0-49ae-bcc3-780d6db2b173","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

Outside site/, and gitignored like the database.\nUPLOADS = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_UPLOADS\", \"uploads\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.auth import csrf_token\nfrom app.flash import confirmation\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    template never hard-codes a route's path. Reverses ADR-004's deferral of\ncharts drawn from a data block.\n**Date:** 2026-10-01\n\n## Context\n\nADR-004 gave Data Bites and Reports uploaded **Chart images** and deferred\ncharts the CMS draws itself. Making a chart still means Excel, an export, an\nupload, and `image:<name>`. Spec #14 asks for a **Chart** built from data typed\nor pasted into the CMS, so a survey result gets a chart without leaving it.\n\nThere's no charting library (`pyproject.toml` is fixed), and the public site\nhas no JavaScript. Whatever draws the chart has to be server-side Python, and\nit has to put SVG into pages *after* nh3, which would strip it otherwise.\n\n## Decision\n\n**A Chart is a `chart` fence in the body, holding one strict JSON object,\ndrawn by the server as inline SVG.** The body is still Markdown (ADR-005).\n`app.charts` owns the grammar (version 1, spec #14's table) and the number,\nunit, missing, and suppressed rules. `app.chart_drawing` draws a Chart that\nhas passed them, and `app.rendering` puts it in the page.\n\n- **Strict, and checked on every save.** The JSON is parsed by stdlib `json`\n  with duplicate keys, `NaN`, and `Infinity` refused. Unknown keys, wrong\n  types, over-long or multi-line strings, and blocks over 32 KB are refused.\n  A cell that isn't a number is refused unless it's a missing or suppressed\n  value. Whatever draws the chart has to be server-side Python, and\nit has to put SVG into pages *after* nh3, which would strip it otherwise.\n\n## Decision\n\n**A Chart is a `chart` fence in the body, holding one strict JSON object,\ndrawn by the server as inline SVG.** The body is still Markdown (ADR-005).\n`app.charts` owns the grammar (version 1, spec #14's table) and the number,\nunit, missing, and suppressed rules. `app.chart_drawing` draws a Chart that\nhas passed them, and `app.rendering` puts it in the page.\n\n- **Strict, and checked on every save.** The JSON is parsed by stdlib `json`\n  with duplicate keys, `NaN`, and `Infinity` refused. Unknown keys, wrong\n  types, over-long or multi-line strings, and blocks over 32 KB are refused.\n  A cell that isn't a number is refused unless it's a missing or suppressed\n  value. {"parentUuid":"f3c101fc-f378-49dc-b96d-18a1ba050fd3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbuEb3JWywyNevpTazwU","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Here's my plan for **T19: Public site look and feel** (#23). Your CLAUDE.md asks for a plan and approval before multi-task work, so I haven't changed any code yet.\n\n**Plan.** I'll commit after each group and stop for your go-ahead after 1–3.\n\n1. **Split the stylesheets (ADR-007).**\n   - Move today's CSS into `static/admin.css`, with no rules changed. The only rule that leaves is the public preview banner.\n   - Admin pages and `/login` link to `admin.css` at a new route.\n   - `app.public_site.CSS` is removed. `static/site.css` becomes the public `style.css`, served by the app, the Site preview and `cms publish`.\n   - Fonts are served at `fonts/*.woff2` in all three places.\n   - Tests: no public page links `admin.css`, no admin page links `site.css`, and the stylesheet and fonts are served and exported.\n2. **New public layout (`public/layout.html`, separate from `base.html`).**\n   - Skip link, purple header with the plotting grid, and numbered nav: Reports in title order, then Data Bites. The current page gets `aria-current=\"page\"`.\n   - Footer on the purple field. Preview banner restyled.\n3. **`static/site.css` from the mockup.**\n   - Tokens, light and dark modes, nav that scrolls sideways with an edge fade.\n   - Item pages: breadcrumb, title and facts row (Published, Type, PDF) on the purple field, with the body at 44rem.\n   - Data Bites list with ISO dates in mono, tables restyled with mono numeric columns, and Charts recoloured using only class selectors and `:has()`. Charts are capped at 40rem.\n   - Focus ring, reduced motion, and a print stylesheet.\n4. **Pages.** Home (latest Data Bites and Reports, numbered sections), both lists, Data Bite, Report and Site preview all move to the new markup. I'll update the tests that assert on the old markup and give the reasons in the commit.\n5. **`404.html` in `cms publish`.**\n   - Uses `<base href=CMS_BASE_PATH>` when that is set. Otherwise it inlines its CSS and links to `index.html`.\n   - New test that the export has no root-absolute `href`/`src` and that `404.html` holds the only `<base>`.\n6. **Contrast table.** I'll compute the ratio of every text and chart-mark pair in both themes, then run the full suite and `/code-review`.\n7. **Browser check, closing comment and closing commit.**\n   - I'll screenshot every page type at 390, 768 and 1440 px, in light and dark, check `document.fonts`, and check for horizontal scroll at 390 px.\n   - Last time, 768 and 1440 px couldn't be done in this environment, so I may need your help with those widths."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2969,"cache_read_input_tokens":106819,"output_tokens":2384,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":395},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2969,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2384,"cache_read_input_tokens":106819,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2969,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2969},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"87187521-ce73-41b0-b233-6a239e0ed342","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfbuEabkQKPA8PXJDVcyY","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"ce3c62b2-206d-4829-a473-093ad9d1f99a","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:20:50.180Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
