And as\n    crawl() follows every link from the home page, failing on a root-absolute\n    or broken one, every exported link is relative and resolves.\"\"\"\n    publish_a_full_site(client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\"))\n\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    live = {path.removeprefix(\"/\"): content for path, content in published_bite(director, body=payload)\n    published_report(director, body=payload)\n\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    for path in (\"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"reports/factbook.html\"):\n        html = site[path].decode()\n        assert \"Hi\" in html and \"<script\" not in html and \"onerror\" not in html, path\n\n\ndef count\")\n\n\n\ndef test_no_draft_is_reachable_anywhere_on_the_public_site(client_as, client):\n    a_site_with_drafts(client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\"))\n\n    site = crawl(client)\n It leaves the site, so it is not followed.\n    assert \"csrf_token\" not in page and \"/admin\" not in without_preview_marks(page)\n\n\ndef test_a_data_bites_preview_has_its_date_line(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n    created = stored_row(\"data-bites\", bid)[\"created_at\"][:10]\n    page = preview(analyst, \"data-bites\", bid, **BITE).text\n    assert f'<p class=\"data-bite-meta\"><small><time datetime=\"{created}\">{created}</time>' in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, publish\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_site_preview_is_the_page_the_export_will_write(\n        client_as, tmp_path, kind, item, create, publish):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = publish(director, body=CHART)\n    upload = upload_to_bite if kind == \"data-bites\" else upload_to_report\n    upload(director, item_id, png())\n    if kind == \"reports\":\n        assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{item_id}\", {**item, \"body\": CHART},\n                              pdf()).status_code == 303\n    published_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Common Data Set 2025-26\")\n\n    page = preview(director, kind, item_id, **{**item, \"body\": CHART}).text\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert without_preview_marks(page) == site[f\"{kind}/{item['slug']}.html\"].decode()\n    assert img_tags(page) == [f'<img src=\"../images/{kind}/{item[\"slug\"]}/fall-by-class.png\"'\n                              ' alt=\"Fall enrollment by class\">']\n\n\ndef test_a_reports_preview_links_its_attached_file(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert post_with_file(analyst, \"/admin/reports\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    rid = report_id(analyst, REPORT[\"slug\"])\n    page = preview(analyst, \"reports\", rid, **REPORT).text\n    assert ('<a href=\"../reports/files/factbook.pdf\" download=\"factbook-2026.pdf\">'\n            'Download factbook-2026.pdf</a>') in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, publish\", KINDS)\ndef {"parentUuid":"9ec0bf69-b7d7-4320-bf6a-ab3c8207a365","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"01cb2c3d-c5a2-4062-8fae-e2b29dd04c71","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Gw9HWxZ5kXCH6dfsjbZk1a","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Login and logout.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, users\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nLOGIN_FAILED = \"Invalid email or password.\"\n\n\ndef _login_page(request: Request, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"home_path\": \"/login\", \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return _login_page(request)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\", dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_csrf)])\ndef login(request: Request, email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    user = users.authenticate(email, password)\n    if user is None:\n        # Same message whether the account is unknown, inactive, or the\n        # password is wrong.\n        return _login_page(request, LOGIN_FAILED, status_code=401)\n    auth.log_in(request, user)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\", dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_csrf)])\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    auth.log_out(request)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"dd1a0fde-c561-4233-8023-613f5a6e637f","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:29:07.516Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Login and logout.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, users\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nLOGIN_FAILED = \"Invalid email or password.\"\n\n\ndef _login_page(request: Request, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"home_path\": \"/login\", \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return _login_page(request)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\", dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_csrf)])\ndef login(request: Request, email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    user = users.authenticate(email, password)\n    if user is None:\n        # Same message whether the account is unknown, inactive, or the\n        # password is wrong.\n        return _login_page(request, LOGIN_FAILED, status_code=401)\n    auth.log_in(request, user)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\", dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_csrf)])\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    auth.log_out(request)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false,"bashEditDiff":{"files":[{"filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/site_preview.py","hunks":[{"oldStart":10,"oldLines":8,"newStart":10,"newLines":7,"lines":[" from fastapi import HTTPException"," from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response"," ","-from app import chart_images","-from app import public_site","+from app import chart_images, public_site"," from app.routes.public import asset, pdf_response"," "," # {"parentUuid":"b6370e15-9d09-4ece-b246-7480ebdb32e8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbuthLscM3gq8eUZz8yp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PPsvvzNZeKKgdz5EtcXkYH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/layout.html","content":"{# Every public page, \"set like a dataset\" (spec #22, ADR-007). Standalone:\n   the admin console's layout is base.html, and neither links the other's\n   stylesheet. Links are relative to the site's root via `root`, never\n   root-absolute, so the pages work exported to a Pages subfolder.\n\n   Two pages carry a <base>: a Site preview (`preview_base`,\n   app.public_site.Page.render_preview), which also shows its banner, and\n   404.html (`site_base`, app.public_site.not_found), which GitHub Pages\n   serves at whatever path was missed. Without a site_base, 404.html inlines\n   its stylesheet (`inline_css`) instead of linking it. #}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import nav_number with context %}\n{%- set base_href = preview_base or site_base -%}\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- if base_href %}\n  <base href=\"{{ base_href }}\">{% endif %}\n  <title>{% if page_title %}{{ page_title }} · {% endif %}{{ title }}</title>\n  {%- if inline_css %}\n  <style>{{ inline_css }}</style>\n  {%- else %}\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ root }}style.css\">\n  {%- endif %}\n</head>\n<body>\n  {#- A fragment link resolves against a <base> on 404.html, the site's\n      root, so there it would leave the page. #}\n  {%- if not site_base %}\n  <a class=\"skip-link\" href=\"#main\">Skip to content</a>\n  {%- endif %}\n  <div class=\"field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n    {%- if preview_base %}\n    <p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">Draft preview, not published</p>{% endif %}\n    <header class=\"header-site\">\n      <a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path }}\"><span class=\"header-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span><b class=\"header-home-text\">{{ title }}</b></a>\n    </header>\n    <nav class=\"nav-site\" aria-label=\"Site\"><ul>\n      {%- for report in nav_reports %}{% set path = report_path(report.slug) %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}{{ path }}\"{% if path == page_path %} aria-current=\"page\"{% endif %}>{{ nav_number(loop.index) }}{{ report.title }}</a></li>\n      {%- endfor %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}data-bites/index.html\"\n        {%- if page_path == \"data-bites/index.html\" %} aria-current=\"page\"\n        {%- elif page_path.startswith(\"data-bites/\") %} aria-current=\"true\"{% endif %}>{{ nav_number(nav_reports | length + 1) }}Data Bites</a></li>\n    </ul></nav>\n  </div></div>\n  <main id=\"main\">\n    {%- block field %}{% endblock %}\n    <div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n      {%- block content %}{% endblock %}\n    </div>\n  </main>\n  <footer class=\"footer-site field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n {"parentUuid":"6d9b5e59-a2dc-4f5c-b2ab-7618151e30ec","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfbv378q9zEv3yFFZoMZE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XWZsnTpYWKyhprdSE4D5A2","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/static/site.css","content":"/* The public site's stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root (ADR-007):\n   \"set like a dataset\" (spec #22). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text and\n   Mono for figures and labels, built so 0/O and 1/l/I can't be confused.\n   Solid fields of deep purple with a faint plotting grid, Kenyon purple and\n   bright purple on paper, and one citron accent, used only on the purple\n   field (and for one Chart series in dark mode, where the paper is dark).\n   Never linked from an admin page; the console's is static/admin.css.\n\n   Text contrast, both themes, is listed in the closing comment of T19 (#23):\n   body text and labels at least 4.5:1, large text and Chart marks 3:1. */\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-italic.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: italic; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Mono\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --font-text: \"Atkinson Next\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  --font-mono: \"Atkinson Mono\", ui-monospace, monospace;\n  --color-paper: #fbfafd;\n  --color-ink: #17131f;\n  --color-muted: #5d5870;\n  --color-line: #e2dfe9;\n  --color-tint: #f0edf8;\n  --color-field: #231443;          /* the deep purple fields */\n  --color-field-line: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16);\n  --color-field-grid: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045);\n  --color-field-text: #d9d3f0;\n  --color-purple: #4b2e84;         /* Kenyon purple */\n  --color-bright: #8f80ff;         /* Kenyon bright purple */\n  --color-citron: #d6f550;         /* only ever on --color-field */\n  /* Chart series (the newest last): Kenyon purple, then green, then bright\n     purple, then a muted violet. Citron is too pale on paper for a mark, so\n     the light theme's green is a deep olive. */\n  --color-chart-newest: var(--color-purple);\n  --color-chart-green: #6b8a00;\n  --color-chart-bright: var(--color-bright);\n  --color-chart-oldest: #a39db3;\n  --width-page: 78rem;\n  --width-measure: 44rem;\n}\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  :root {\n    --color-paper: #110e17;\n    --color-ink: #ebe8f2;\n    --color-muted: #a39db3;\n    --color-line: #2b2737;\n    --color-tint: #1b1726;\n    --color-field: #1a0f33;\n    --color-purple: #a99cff;\n    --color-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-green: var(--color-citron);\n    --color-chart-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-oldest: #6f6982;\n  }\n}\n\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1.125rem/1.65 var(--font-text); margin: 0; }\na { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }\na:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }\n.field-site :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-citron); }\nh1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; }\n.layout-wrap { margin-inline: auto; max-width: var(--width-page); padding-inline: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.skip-link { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); font-weight: 700; left: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; position: absolute; top: -4rem; z-index: 5; }\n.skip-link:focus { top: 0.5rem; }\n.text-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }\n.text-label { font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n/* The purple field: the header on every page, then the home intro or a\n   page's title, and the footer. A faint plotting grid sits under it. */\n.field-site { background-color: var(--color-field); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-position: -1px -1px; background-size: 3rem 3rem; color: #fff; }\n.field-site a { color: #fff; }\n\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-citron); font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin: 0; padding-block: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n.header-site { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 1rem 2rem; padding-block: 1.25rem; }\n.header-home { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; text-decoration: none; }\n.header-mark { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); display: grid; flex: none; font: 700 1.05rem/1 var(--font-mono); height: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; }\n.header-home-text { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.25; }\n\n/* Numbered nav: the Reports, then Data Bites. On a phone it scrolls\n   sideways, fading at the edge, and never wraps. */\n.nav-site { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; gap: 0 2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0; scrollbar-width: none; }\n.nav-site ul::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }\n.nav-site a { border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; display: flex; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; gap: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0.85rem 0.7rem; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }\n.nav-site a .text-mono { color: var(--color-bright); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; padding-top: 0.12rem; }\n.nav-site a:hover { border-color: var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site a[aria-current] { border-color: var(--color-citron); }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) {\n  .nav-site ul { gap: 0 1.4rem; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 80%, transparent); padding-right: 2.5rem; }\n}\n\n/* The home intro. */\n.intro-home { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem); }\n.intro-home h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.6vw, 4.4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; max-width: 18ch; }\n.intro-home-lede { color: var(--color-field-text); font-size: 1.2rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; max-width: 36rem; }\n\n/* A page's title on the field: breadcrumb, title, and its facts row. */\n.title-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-top: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.75rem); }\n.nav-breadcrumb, .nav-breadcrumb a { color: var(--color-field-text); }\n.title-item h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.4vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 1rem 0; max-width: 20ch; overflow-wrap: break-word; }\n.meta-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 2.5rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0; padding-block: 1rem; }\n.meta-item div { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; min-width: 0; }\n.meta-item dt { color: var(--color-bright); }\n.meta-item dd { color: #fff; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.meta-item a { color: var(--color-citron); }\n\n/* Sections on paper: a mono number, a heading, and a link. */\n.section-home { padding-top: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); }\n.section-list { padding-top: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.head-section { align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-ink); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.6rem; }\n.head-section > .text-mono { color: var(--color-purple); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n.head-section h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; }\n.head-section a { color: var(--color-muted); margin-left: auto; }\n\n/* Data Bites and Reports: an ISO date column, then the title. */\n.list-data-bites, .list-reports { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\n.list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: grid; gap: 0.15rem 2rem; grid-template-columns: 8rem minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 1.15rem 0; position: relative; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover, .list-reports li:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-tint), transparent); }\n.list-data-bites .text-mono, .list-reports .text-mono { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; padding-top: 0.25rem; }\n.list-data-bites a, .list-reports a { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-decoration: none; }\n/* The whole row is the link's target. */\n.list-data-bites a::after, .list-reports a::after { content: \"\"; inset: 0; position: absolute; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover a, .list-reports li:hover a { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration: underline; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n\n/* An item's body, at a readable measure. */\n.body-item { max-width: var(--width-measure); padding-top: 2.5rem; }\n.link-back { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); margin: 2.5rem 0 0; max-width: var(--width-measure); padding-top: 1rem; }\n\n.content-body { overflow-wrap: break-word; }\n.content-body p, .content-body ul, .content-body ol { margin: 0 0 1.15rem; }\n.content-body h1 { font-size: 2rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0.8rem; }\n.content-body h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0.8rem; }\n.content-body h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 2rem 0 0.6rem; }\n.content-body code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.9em; }\n.content-body blockquote { border-left: 3px solid var(--color-bright); margin: 1.5rem 0; padding-left: 1rem; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n\n/* Tables (T09), by class only: hairline rules, a mono header, and mono\n   figures in right-aligned columns. A wide one scrolls sideways in its\n   wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening the page. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin: 1.75rem 0; overflow-x: auto; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; }\n.content-body thead th { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-purple); color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 0.78rem var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding-top: 0; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: bottom; }\n.content-body tbody th { font-weight: 600; text-align: left; }\n.content-body td[style*=\"right\"] { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }\n.content-body th:first-child, .content-body td:first-child { padding-left: 0; }\n.content-body th:last-child, .content-body td:last-child { padding-right: 0; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n\n/* Charts (app.chart_drawing), recoloured by class only. The SVG scales to\n   the column, but no wider than the 40rem it is drawn for, so its text stays\n   near FONT pixels. Each is drawn twice; the narrow drawing replaces the\n   wide one on a phone, and display: none takes the hidden one out of the\n   accessibility tree. */\n.chart-figure { margin: 2.25rem 0; max-width: 40rem; }\n.chart-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }\n.chart-svg, .chart-svg-phone { display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }\n.chart-svg-phone { display: none; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .chart-svg { display: none; } .chart-svg-phone { display: block; } }\n.chart-figure text { fill: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: 13px; }\n.chart-figure .chart-tick, .chart-figure .chart-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); }\n.chart-figure .chart-value { fill: var(--color-ink); }\n.chart-figure .chart-grid { stroke: var(--color-line); }\n.chart-figure .chart-baseline { stroke: var(--color-muted); }\n.chart-figure polyline { stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }\n.chart-figure circle { stroke: var(--color-paper); }\n/* Series by how many the Chart has, the newest (the last) in Kenyon purple. */\n.chart-figure { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-2, .chart-line-2) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-green); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-3, .chart-line-3) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-bright); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-green); --chart-3: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-4, .chart-line-4) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-oldest); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-bright); Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text and\n   Mono for figures and labels, built so 0/O and 1/l/I can't be confused.\n   Solid fields of deep purple with a faint plotting grid, Kenyon purple and\n   bright purple on paper, and one citron accent, used only on the purple\n   field (and for one Chart series in dark mode, where the paper is dark).\n   Never linked from an admin page; the console's is static/admin.css.\n\n   Text contrast, both themes, is listed in the closing comment of T19 (#23):\n   body text and labels at least 4.5:1, large text and Chart marks 3:1. */\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-italic.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: italic; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Mono\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --font-text: \"Atkinson Next\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  --font-mono: \"Atkinson Mono\", ui-monospace, monospace;\n  --color-paper: #fbfafd;\n  --color-ink: #17131f;\n  --color-muted: #5d5870;\n  --color-line: #e2dfe9;\n  --color-tint: #f0edf8;\n  --color-field: #231443;          /* the deep purple fields */\n  --color-field-line: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16);\n  --color-field-grid: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045);\n  --color-field-text: #d9d3f0;\n  --color-purple: #4b2e84;         /* Kenyon purple */\n  --color-bright: #8f80ff;         /* Kenyon bright purple */\n  --color-citron: #d6f550;         /* only ever on --color-field */\n  /* Chart series (the newest last): Kenyon purple, then green, then bright\n     purple, then a muted violet. Citron is too pale on paper for a mark, so\n     the light theme's green is a deep olive. */\n  --color-chart-newest: var(--color-purple);\n  --color-chart-green: #6b8a00;\n  --color-chart-bright: var(--color-bright);\n  --color-chart-oldest: #a39db3;\n  --width-page: 78rem;\n  --width-measure: 44rem;\n}\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  :root {\n    --color-paper: #110e17;\n    --color-ink: #ebe8f2;\n    --color-muted: #a39db3;\n    --color-line: #2b2737;\n    --color-tint: #1b1726;\n    --color-field: #1a0f33;\n    --color-purple: #a99cff;\n    --color-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-green: var(--color-citron);\n    --color-chart-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-oldest: #6f6982;\n  }\n}\n\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1.125rem/1.65 var(--font-text); margin: 0; }\na { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }\na:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }\n.field-site :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-citron); }\nh1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; }\n.layout-wrap { margin-inline: auto; max-width: var(--width-page); padding-inline: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.skip-link { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); font-weight: 700; left: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; position: absolute; top: -4rem; z-index: 5; }\n.skip-link:focus { top: 0.5rem; }\n.text-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }\n.text-label { font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n/* The purple field: the header on every page, then the home intro or a\n   page's title, and the footer. A faint plotting grid sits under it. */\n.field-site { background-color: var(--color-field); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-position: -1px -1px; background-size: 3rem 3rem; color: #fff; }\n.field-site a { color: #fff; }\n\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-citron); font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin: 0; padding-block: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n.header-site { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 1rem 2rem; padding-block: 1.25rem; }\n.header-home { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; text-decoration: none; }\n.header-mark { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); display: grid; flex: none; font: 700 1.05rem/1 var(--font-mono); height: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; }\n.header-home-text { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.25; }\n\n/* Numbered nav: the Reports, then Data Bites. On a phone it scrolls\n   sideways, fading at the edge, and never wraps. */\n.nav-site { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; gap: 0 2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0; scrollbar-width: none; }\n.nav-site ul::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }\n.nav-site a { border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; display: flex; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; gap: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0.85rem 0.7rem; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }\n.nav-site a .text-mono { color: var(--color-bright); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; padding-top: 0.12rem; }\n.nav-site a:hover { border-color: var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site a[aria-current] { border-color: var(--color-citron); }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) {\n  .nav-site ul { gap: 0 1.4rem; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 80%, transparent); padding-right: 2.5rem; }\n}\n\n/* The home intro. */\n.intro-home { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem); }\n.intro-home h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.6vw, 4.4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; max-width: 18ch; }\n.intro-home-lede { color: var(--color-field-text); font-size: 1.2rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; max-width: 36rem; }\n\n/* A page's title on the field: breadcrumb, title, and its facts row. */\n.title-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-top: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.75rem); }\n.nav-breadcrumb, .nav-breadcrumb a { color: var(--color-field-text); }\n.title-item h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.4vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 1rem 0; max-width: 20ch; overflow-wrap: break-word; }\n.meta-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 2.5rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0; padding-block: 1rem; }\n.meta-item div { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; min-width: 0; }\n.meta-item dt { color: var(--color-bright); }\n.meta-item dd { color: #fff; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.meta-item a { color: var(--color-citron); }\n\n/* Sections on paper: a mono number, a heading, and a link. */\n.section-home { padding-top: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); }\n.section-list { padding-top: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.head-section { align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-ink); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.6rem; }\n.head-section > .text-mono { color: var(--color-purple); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n.head-section h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; }\n.head-section a { color: var(--color-muted); margin-left: auto; }\n\n/* Data Bites and Reports: an ISO date column, then the title. */\n.list-data-bites, .list-reports { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\n.list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: grid; gap: 0.15rem 2rem; grid-template-columns: 8rem minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 1.15rem 0; position: relative; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover, .list-reports li:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-tint), transparent); }\n.list-data-bites .text-mono, .list-reports .text-mono { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; padding-top: 0.25rem; }\n.list-data-bites a, .list-reports a { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-decoration: none; }\n/* The whole row is the link's target. */\n.list-data-bites a::after, .list-reports a::after { content: \"\"; inset: 0; position: absolute; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover a, .list-reports li:hover a { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration: underline; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n\n/* An item's body, at a readable measure. */\n.body-item { max-width: var(--width-measure); padding-top: 2.5rem; }\n.link-back { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); margin: 2.5rem 0 0; max-width: var(--width-measure); }\n.content-body h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0.8rem; }\n.content-body h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 2rem 0 0.6rem; }\n.content-body code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.9em; }\n.content-body blockquote { border-left: 3px solid var(--color-bright); margin: 1.5rem 0; padding-left: 1rem; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n\n/* Tables (T09), by class only: hairline rules, a mono header, and mono\n   figures in right-aligned columns. } .chart-svg-phone { display: block; } }\n.chart-figure text { fill: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: 13px; }\n.chart-figure .chart-tick, .chart-figure .chart-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); {"parentUuid":"001d4eb6-bd57-4523-a2ce-751ea0aa505e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"01cb2c3d-c5a2-4062-8fae-e2b29dd04c71","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XWZsnTpYWKyhprdSE4D5A2","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/static/site.css (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"85523d7d-4a51-4b98-826d-0839c685d88f","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:31:56.560Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/static/site.css","content":"/* The public site's stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root (ADR-007):\n   \"set like a dataset\" (spec #22). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text and\n   Mono for figures and labels, built so 0/O and 1/l/I can't be confused.\n   Solid fields of deep purple with a faint plotting grid, Kenyon purple and\n   bright purple on paper, and one citron accent, used only on the purple\n   field (and for one Chart series in dark mode, where the paper is dark).\n   Never linked from an admin page; the console's is static/admin.css.\n\n   Text contrast, both themes, is listed in the closing comment of T19 (#23):\n   body text and labels at least 4.5:1, large text and Chart marks 3:1. */\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Next\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-italic.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: italic; font-display: swap; }\n@font-face { font-family: \"Atkinson Mono\"; src: url(\"fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2\") format(\"woff2\"); font-weight: 200 800; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }\n\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --font-text: \"Atkinson Next\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  --font-mono: \"Atkinson Mono\", ui-monospace, monospace;\n  --color-paper: #fbfafd;\n  --color-ink: #17131f;\n  --color-muted: #5d5870;\n  --color-line: #e2dfe9;\n  --color-tint: #f0edf8;\n  --color-field: #231443;          /* the deep purple fields */\n  --color-field-line: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16);\n  --color-field-grid: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045);\n  --color-field-text: #d9d3f0;\n  --color-purple: #4b2e84;         /* Kenyon purple */\n  --color-bright: #8f80ff;         /* Kenyon bright purple */\n  --color-citron: #d6f550;         /* only ever on --color-field */\n  /* Chart series (the newest last): Kenyon purple, then green, then bright\n     purple, then a muted violet. Citron is too pale on paper for a mark, so\n     the light theme's green is a deep olive. */\n  --color-chart-newest: var(--color-purple);\n  --color-chart-green: #6b8a00;\n  --color-chart-bright: var(--color-bright);\n  --color-chart-oldest: #a39db3;\n  --width-page: 78rem;\n  --width-measure: 44rem;\n}\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  :root {\n    --color-paper: #110e17;\n    --color-ink: #ebe8f2;\n    --color-muted: #a39db3;\n    --color-line: #2b2737;\n    --color-tint: #1b1726;\n    --color-field: #1a0f33;\n    --color-purple: #a99cff;\n    --color-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-green: var(--color-citron);\n    --color-chart-bright: #7d6ef0;\n    --color-chart-oldest: #6f6982;\n  }\n}\n\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1.125rem/1.65 var(--font-text); margin: 0; }\na { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }\na:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }\n.field-site :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-citron); }\nh1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; }\n.layout-wrap { margin-inline: auto; max-width: var(--width-page); padding-inline: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.skip-link { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); font-weight: 700; left: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; position: absolute; top: -4rem; z-index: 5; }\n.skip-link:focus { top: 0.5rem; }\n.text-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }\n.text-label { font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n/* The purple field: the header on every page, then the home intro or a\n   page's title, and the footer. A faint plotting grid sits under it. */\n.field-site { background-color: var(--color-field); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-field-grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-position: -1px -1px; background-size: 3rem 3rem; color: #fff; }\n.field-site a { color: #fff; }\n\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-citron); font: 500 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin: 0; padding-block: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; }\n\n.header-site { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 1rem 2rem; padding-block: 1.25rem; }\n.header-home { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; text-decoration: none; }\n.header-mark { background: var(--color-citron); color: var(--color-field); display: grid; flex: none; font: 700 1.05rem/1 var(--font-mono); height: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; }\n.header-home-text { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.25; }\n\n/* Numbered nav: the Reports, then Data Bites. On a phone it scrolls\n   sideways, fading at the edge, and never wraps. */\n.nav-site { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; gap: 0 2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0; scrollbar-width: none; }\n.nav-site ul::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }\n.nav-site a { border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; display: flex; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; gap: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0.85rem 0.7rem; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }\n.nav-site a .text-mono { color: var(--color-bright); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; padding-top: 0.12rem; }\n.nav-site a:hover { border-color: var(--color-field-line); }\n.nav-site a[aria-current] { border-color: var(--color-citron); }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) {\n  .nav-site ul { gap: 0 1.4rem; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 80%, transparent); padding-right: 2.5rem; }\n}\n\n/* The home intro. */\n.intro-home { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem); }\n.intro-home h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.6vw, 4.4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; max-width: 18ch; }\n.intro-home-lede { color: var(--color-field-text); font-size: 1.2rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; max-width: 36rem; }\n\n/* A page's title on the field: breadcrumb, title, and its facts row. */\n.title-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); padding-top: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.75rem); }\n.nav-breadcrumb, .nav-breadcrumb a { color: var(--color-field-text); }\n.title-item h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.4vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 1rem 0; max-width: 20ch; overflow-wrap: break-word; }\n.meta-item { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-field-line); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 2.5rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0; padding-block: 1rem; }\n.meta-item div { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; min-width: 0; }\n.meta-item dt { color: var(--color-bright); }\n.meta-item dd { color: #fff; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.meta-item a { color: var(--color-citron); }\n\n/* Sections on paper: a mono number, a heading, and a link. */\n.section-home { padding-top: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); }\n.section-list { padding-top: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); }\n.head-section { align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-ink); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.6rem; }\n.head-section > .text-mono { color: var(--color-purple); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n.head-section h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; }\n.head-section a { color: var(--color-muted); margin-left: auto; }\n\n/* Data Bites and Reports: an ISO date column, then the title. */\n.list-data-bites, .list-reports { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\n.list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: grid; gap: 0.15rem 2rem; grid-template-columns: 8rem minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 1.15rem 0; position: relative; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover, .list-reports li:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-tint), transparent); }\n.list-data-bites .text-mono, .list-reports .text-mono { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; padding-top: 0.25rem; }\n.list-data-bites a, .list-reports a { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-decoration: none; }\n/* The whole row is the link's target. */\n.list-data-bites a::after, .list-reports a::after { content: \"\"; inset: 0; position: absolute; }\n.list-data-bites li:hover a, .list-reports li:hover a { color: var(--color-purple); text-decoration: underline; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .list-data-bites li, .list-reports li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n\n/* An item's body, at a readable measure. */\n.body-item { max-width: var(--width-measure); padding-top: 2.5rem; }\n.link-back { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); margin: 2.5rem 0 0; max-width: var(--width-measure); padding-top: 1rem; }\n\n.content-body { overflow-wrap: break-word; }\n.content-body p, .content-body ul, .content-body ol { margin: 0 0 1.15rem; }\n.content-body h1 { font-size: 2rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0.8rem; }\n.content-body h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0.8rem; }\n.content-body h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 2rem 0 0.6rem; }\n.content-body code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.9em; }\n.content-body blockquote { border-left: 3px solid var(--color-bright); margin: 1.5rem 0; padding-left: 1rem; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n\n/* Tables (T09), by class only: hairline rules, a mono header, and mono\n   figures in right-aligned columns. A wide one scrolls sideways in its\n   wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening the page. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin: 1.75rem 0; overflow-x: auto; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; }\n.content-body thead th { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-purple); color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 0.78rem var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding-top: 0; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: bottom; }\n.content-body tbody th { font-weight: 600; text-align: left; }\n.content-body td[style*=\"right\"] { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }\n.content-body th:first-child, .content-body td:first-child { padding-left: 0; }\n.content-body th:last-child, .content-body td:last-child { padding-right: 0; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n\n/* Charts (app.chart_drawing), recoloured by class only. The SVG scales to\n   the column, but no wider than the 40rem it is drawn for, so its text stays\n   near FONT pixels. Each is drawn twice; the narrow drawing replaces the\n   wide one on a phone, and display: none takes the hidden one out of the\n   accessibility tree. */\n.chart-figure { margin: 2.25rem 0; max-width: 40rem; }\n.chart-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }\n.chart-svg, .chart-svg-phone { display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }\n.chart-svg-phone { display: none; }\n@media (max-width: 30rem) { .chart-svg { display: none; } .chart-svg-phone { display: block; } }\n.chart-figure text { fill: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: 13px; }\n.chart-figure .chart-tick, .chart-figure .chart-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); }\n.chart-figure .chart-value { fill: var(--color-ink); }\n.chart-figure .chart-grid { stroke: var(--color-line); }\n.chart-figure .chart-baseline { stroke: var(--color-muted); }\n.chart-figure polyline { stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }\n.chart-figure circle { stroke: var(--color-paper); }\n/* Series by how many the Chart has, the newest (the last) in Kenyon purple. */\n.chart-figure { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-2, .chart-line-2) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-green); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-3, .chart-line-3) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-bright); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-green); --chart-3: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-figure:has(.chart-series-4, .chart-line-4) { --chart-1: var(--color-chart-oldest); --chart-2: var(--color-chart-bright); --chart-3: var(--color-chart-green); --chart-4: var(--color-chart-newest); }\n.chart-series-1, .chart-marker-1 { fill: var(--chart-1); } .chart-line-1 { stroke: var(--chart-1); }\n.chart-series-2, .chart-marker-2 { fill: var(--chart-2); } .chart-line-2 { stroke: var(--chart-2); }\n.chart-series-3, .chart-marker-3 { fill: var(--chart-3); } .chart-line-3 { stroke: var(--chart-3); }\n.chart-series-4, .chart-marker-4 { fill: var(--chart-4); } .chart-line-4 { stroke: var(--chart-4); }\n.chart-note, .chart-source { color: var(--color-muted); margin: 0.25rem 0; }\n.chart-data { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.6rem; overflow-x: auto; padding-top: 0.5rem; }\n.chart-data summary { color: var(--color-purple); cursor: pointer; font: 500 0.8rem var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }\n.content-body .chart-data td { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; text-align: right; }\n\n/* The footer, back on the field. */\n.footer-site { margin-top: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem); }\n.footer-site .layout-wrap { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem 3rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); padding-block: 2.5rem 3rem; }\n.footer-site p { color: var(--color-field-text); font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0.4rem 0 0; }\n.footer-site .text-label { color: var(--color-bright); }\n@media (max-width: 48rem) { .footer-site .layout-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n  *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition: none !important; }\n}\n\n/* Print: black on white, without the field, the nav, or the footer. Links\n   are relative, so their addresses aren't printed after them. */\n@media print {\n  :root { --color-paper: #fff; --color-ink: #000; --color-muted: #333; --color-line: #999; --color-purple: #000; }\n  body { font-size: 11pt; }\n  .field-site { background: none; color: #000; }\n  .field-site a, .nav-breadcrumb, .nav-breadcrumb a, .meta-item dt, .meta-item dd, .meta-item a, .intro-home-lede { color: #000; }\n  .skip-link, .nav-site, .nav-breadcrumb, .footer-site, .site-preview-banner, .link-back { display: none; }\n  .header-site { padding-block: 0 0.5rem; }\n  .header-mark { border: 1px solid #000; }\n  .title-item, .intro-home, .meta-item { border-color: #000; padding-top: 0.5rem; }\n  .title-item h1, .intro-home h1 { font-size: 22pt; }\n  .meta-item { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n  .body-item { max-width: none; padding-top: 1rem; }\n  .chart-figure, .content-body table { break-inside: avoid; }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"001d4eb6-bd57-4523-a2ce-751ea0aa505e","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

Public site look and feel (issue #23, spec #22, ADR-007).\n\nThe public site has its own stylesheet and self-hosted fonts, served and\nexported at the same relative paths, and the admin console keeps its own.\nEvery public page shares one layout: numbered nav, a title field, ISO dates,\nand a 404.html that works at any depth once CMS_BASE_PATH is set.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\nfrom tests.test_t05_report_files import pdf, post_with_file\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import nav, published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\n\nFONTS = sorted(path.name for path in (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\").glob(\"*.woff2\"))\nPUBLIC_PAGES = [\"/\", \"/data-bites/index.html\", \"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\",\n                \"/reports/index.html\", \"/reports/factbook.html\", \"/404.html\"]\n\n\ndef a_published_site(director: TestClient) -> None:\n    published_bite(director)\n    rid = published_report(director)\n    assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    published_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Common Data Set 2025-26\")\n\n\ndef stylesheets(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n\n\n# Stylesheets and fonts\n\ndef test_the_app_serves_the_stylesheet_and_its_fonts(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert css.status_code == 200 and css.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert css.text == (settings.STATIC / \"site.css\").read_text()\n    assert FONTS, \"no fonts in static/fonts\"\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert f'url(\"fonts/{name}\")' in css.text, name\n        font = client.get(f\"/fonts/{name}\")\n        assert font.status_code == 200 and font.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"font/woff2\", name\n        assert font.content == (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\" / name).read_bytes()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/fonts/nope.woff2\", \"/fonts/..%2Fsite.css\", \"/fonts/\"])\ndef test_only_the_sites_own_fonts_are_served(client, path):\n    assert client.get(path).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_the_stylesheet_fonts_and_licences_and_404(client_as, tmp_path):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert site[\"style.css\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"site.css\").read_bytes()\n    for name in FONTS:\n        assert site[f\"fonts/{name}\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"fonts\" / name).read_bytes()\n    assert {\"fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-next.txt\",\n            \"fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.txt\", \"404.html\"} <= set(site)\n\n\ndef test_public_site_css_is_gone_from_python():\n    assert not hasattr(public_site, \"CSS\")\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", PUBLIC_PAGES)\ndef test_a_public_page_links_only_the_sites_stylesheet(client_as, client, path):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(path).text\n    root = \"../\" * path.removeprefix(\"/\").count(\"/\")\n    assert stylesheets(page) == [f\"{root}style.css\"] or path == \"/404.html\", stylesheets(page)\n    assert \"admin.css\" not in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/login\", \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/users\",\n                                  \"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\",\n                                  \"/admin/reports/new\"])\ndef test_an_admin_page_links_only_the_consoles_stylesheet(client_as, path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(path.format(bid=create_bite(director))).text\n    assert stylesheets(page) == [\"/admin.css\"]\n    assert \"style.css\" not in page.replace(\"Site preview\", \"\")\n\n\ndef test_the_consoles_stylesheet_keeps_todays_look_and_the_sites_has_no_admin_rules(client):\n    admin = client.get(\"/admin.css\")\n    assert admin.status_code == 200 and admin.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert \".admin-editor-toolbar\" in admin.text and \".chart-svg-phone\" in admin.text\n    assert \"Atkinson\" not in admin.text and test_the_stylesheet_has_dark_mode_print_reduced_motion_and_a_focus_ring(client):\n    css = client.get(\"/style.css\").text\n    for needle in (\"@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)\", \"@media print\",\n                   \"@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\", \":focus-visible\", \".skip-link\"):\n        assert needle in css, needle\n    # A Chart is capped at the width it is drawn test_every_public_page_has_the_layout(client_as, client, path):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(path).text\n    assert '<a class=\"skip-link\" href=\"#main\">Skip to content</a>' in page\n    assert '<header class=\"header-site\">' in page and '<main id=\"main\">' in page\n    assert '<footer class=\"footer-site field-site\">' in page\n    assert page.count(\"<h1\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_the_nav_numbers_reports_in_title_order_then_data_bites(client_as, client):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    links = re.findall(r'<a test_the_nav_marks_where_the_visitor_is(client_as, client, path, current, marked):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    shown = nav(client.get(path).text)\n    assert published_bite(client_as(\"editor\"))\n    page = client.get(\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").text\n    field = page[page.index('<div class=\"title-item\">'):page.index('<div ('<dt>PDF</dt><dd><a class=\"report-download\" href=\"../reports/files/factbook.pdf\"'\n            ' download=\"factbook-2026.pdf\">Download factbook-2026.pdf</a></dd>') in facts\n    # A Report with no file has no PDF fact.\n    assert \"<dt>PDF</dt>\" not in client.get(\"/reports/cds.html\").text\n\n\ndef test_public_dates_are_iso(client_as, client):\n    a_published_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    for path in [\"/\", \"/data-bites/index.html\", \"/reports/index.html\",\n                 \"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"/reports/factbook.html\"]:\n        dates = re.findall(r'<time datetime=\"([^\"]*)\">([^<]*)</time>', client.get(path).text)\n        assert dates, path\n        for machine, shown in dates:\n            assert re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", shown) and {"parentUuid":"bc241492-4b1c-4e6b-ba17-4fe132840dca","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"deferred_tools_record","entries":[],"toolInputCopies":[{"id":"toolu_01Q1U9HmKtEcFdSMDyVz2jA9","copy":"wire"}]},"type":"attachment","uuid":"3e4dc407-308d-4d16-a9a8-fcb438675723","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:38:08.933Z","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"3e4dc407-308d-4d16-a9a8-fcb438675723","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbvZ6JoPjoHg6Y97H8wY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MfCa3d8y63w4KNw3jUpJxN","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-007-public-site-stylesheet-and-fonts.md","content":"# ADR-007: The public site's own stylesheet, self-hosted fonts, and 404.html\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #22, ticket #23)\n**Date:** 2026-10-01\n\n## Context\n\nBefore spec #22, the public site and the admin console shared one stylesheet:\na Python string, `app.public_site.CSS`, served at `style.css` and written\nthere by `cms publish`. The public site's rules and every `.admin-*` rule\nwere in it, so each side's styles reached the other's pages. Spec #22 gives\nthe public site a real design (\"set like a dataset\") with its own typefaces,\nand leaves the console's look as it is until a later spec.\n\nThe site is served from a GitHub Pages subfolder with relative paths only\n(ADR-001), and `pyproject.toml` is fixed (ADR-002).\n\n## Decision\n\n- **Two stylesheets, as files.** `static/site.css` is the public site's. The\n  app serves it at `style.css`, the Site preview serves it from its own copy\n  of the site, and `cms publish` copies it to `site/style.css`. All three read\n  the file through `app.public_site.assets()`. `static/admin.css` is the\n  console's: the old rules unchanged, minus the Site preview banner, served at\n  `/admin.css` (outside the login, so the login page has it). It is never\n  exported. `public/layout.html` is a standalone layout and `base.html` stays\n  the console's, so neither links the other's stylesheet. Tests check both\n  directions.\n- **Self-hosted fonts.** Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (roman and italic) and\n  Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, as variable `.woff2` files in `static/fonts/`.\n  Each font's SIL Open Font License is committed beside it. They are served\n  and exported at `fonts/` beside the stylesheet, which loads them by relative\n  `url()`s, together with the licences. The footer links the licences, so they\n  travel with the fonts and the crawler reaches them. There is no CDN: a font\n  host would be a second origin and a request for every visitor.\n- **404.html carries a `<base>`.** GitHub Pages serves `404.html` at whatever\n  missing URL was asked for, at any depth, so a relative link in it resolves\n  against the wrong folder. With `CMS_BASE_PATH` set (the deployed site's\n  URL, given a trailing `/` if it lacks one), `404.html` has\n  `<base href=\"CMS_BASE_PATH\">`, and its links work at any depth. With it\n  unset (local use), it inlines its stylesheet and links as from the site's\n  root, which is right for a miss at the top level. Fonts then load only for\n  a top-level miss.\n- **The crawler's one exception.** The T07/T08 crawler, which fails on any\n  root-absolute or absolute site link, allows exactly one `<base>`, in\n  `404.html`. The crawler starts from `index.html` and `404.html`, and follows\n  the stylesheet's `url()`s. A page with a `<base>` (a Site preview, or\n  `404.html` with `CMS_BASE_PATH`) has no skip link, because a `#main` link\n  would resolve against the `<base>` and leave the page.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- A designer can change the public site's CSS without touching Python, and\n  without risk to the console's styles.\n- The console still looks like it did before spec #22. Its own redesign is a\n  later spec, and it will start from `static/admin.css`.\n- A font update is a file swap. The licence files have to be kept with the\n  fonts.\n- **The citron rule has one exception.** Spec #22 limits citron `#D6F550` to\n  the purple field. The user asked for the green in Charts. Citron on the\n  light paper is 1.2:1, too pale for a mark, so the light theme uses a deep\n  olive `#6B8A00` (3.8:1) for that series, and only dark mode uses citron\n  (15.5:1 on its paper). Series by count, the newest last: Kenyon purple\n  alone; then green before it; then bright purple; then a muted violet.\n\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt changes how every page gets its styles and where the site's files come\nfrom, and the `<base>` in `404.html` is the one exception to ADR-001's\nrelative-links rule. That is surprising without the reason.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":621,"cache_read_input_tokens":183159,"output_tokens":1550,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":621,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1550,"cache_read_input_tokens":183159,"cache_creation_input_tokens":621,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":621},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01MfCa3d8y63w4KNw3jUpJxN":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-007-public-site-stylesheet-and-fonts.md","content":"# ADR-007: The public site's own stylesheet, self-hosted fonts, and 404.html\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #22, ticket #23)\n**Date:** 2026-10-01\n\n## Context\n\nBefore spec #22, the public site and the admin console shared one stylesheet:\na Python string, `app.public_site.CSS`, served at `style.css` and written\nthere by `cms publish`. The footer links the licences, so they\n  travel with the fonts and the crawler reaches them. There is no CDN: a font\n  host would be a second origin and a request for every visitor.\n- **404.html carries a `<base>`.** GitHub Pages serves `404.html` at whatever\n  missing URL was asked for, at any depth, so a relative link in it resolves\n  against the wrong folder. With `CMS_BASE_PATH` set (the deployed site's\n  URL, given a trailing `/` if it lacks one), `404.html` has\n  `<base href=\"CMS_BASE_PATH\">`, and its links work at any depth. With it\n  unset (local use), it inlines its stylesheet and links as from the site's\n  root, which is right for a miss at the top level. The crawler starts from `index.html` and `404.html`, and follows\n  the stylesheet's `url()`s. A page with a `<base>` (a Site preview, or\n  `404.html` with `CMS_BASE_PATH`) has no skip link, because a `#main` link\n  would resolve against the `<base>` and leave the page.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- A designer can change the public site's CSS without touching Python, and\n  without risk to the console's styles.\n- The console still looks like it did before spec #22. Its own redesign is a\n  later spec, and it will start from `static/admin.css`.\n- A font update is a file swap. The licence files have to be kept with the\n  fonts.\n- **The citron rule has one exception.** Spec #22 limits citron `#D6F550` to\n  the purple field. The user asked for the green in Charts. Citron on the\n  light paper is 1.2:1, too pale for a mark, so the light theme uses a deep\n  olive `#6B8A00` (3.8:1) for that series, and only dark mode uses citron\n  (15.5:1 on its paper). Series by count, the newest last: Kenyon purple\n  alone; then green before it; then bright purple; then a muted violet.\n\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt changes how every page gets its styles and where the site's files come\nfrom, and the `<base>` in `404.html` is the one exception to ADR-001's\nrelative-links rule. That is surprising without the reason.\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"de84cd45-2acf-492b-a265-5ab36fc3ad95","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfbvZ5rXPRGc8tFShF98x","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"b19f288a-ff87-4ca7-a163-7929d886e4e2","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:38:08.931Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

Reports stay a styled list (title and updated date) until T20 adds the table.\n- **Footer:** the mockup's text with the placeholder `ir@example.edu`, plus a line linking the fonts' licences so they ship with the fonts.\n- **Stylesheets (ADR-007):** the public site uses `static/site.css`. The console keeps today's look in `static/admin.css`, served at `/admin.css`. Tests check that neither side links the other's stylesheet.\n- **`404.html`:** carries a `<base>` pointing at `CMS_BASE_PATH`. Without that setting it inlines its styles instead. The crawler allows only this one `<base>`.\n- **Accessibility and print:** dark mode, a print stylesheet, reduced motion, a focus ring and a skip link are all in place. Every text and chart-mark pair in both themes meets its contrast target.\n\n**Chart colours: I went slightly past what you picked.**\n- The newest series is Kenyon purple, the one before it green (olive `#6B8A00` in light mode, citron in dark), then bright purple, as agreed.\n- The oldest series of a four-series chart is a muted grey-violet, so no two lines are identical.\n- In dark mode, bright purple sat too close to Kenyon purple to tell apart, so dark-mode Charts use a deeper bright purple (`#6352d6`, 3.4:1).\n\nTwo things behave differently from what you might expect:\n- **No skip link on the Site preview or the deployed `404.html`.** Both pages carry a `<base>`, and under it a `#main` link would jump to another page.\n- **Fonts on `404.html` need `CMS_BASE_PATH`.** Without it, the fonts and the home link only work for a missing page at the top level of the site.\n\nSo far I've only spot-checked: an item page at 1440 px in light mode, and the four-series chart at 390 px in dark mode, where both Atkinson fonts loaded and nothing scrolled sideways.\n\nScreenshot (1440 px, light): `/var/folders/ng/p9btd2gd2nl52482qg2dd9700000gn/T/claude-chrome-screenshots-kTW0t0/screenshot-1790876954910-84.jpg`\n\n**Still to do if you say go:**\n1. cat > $SP/triptych.html <<'EOF'\n<!doctype html>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n<title>T19 triptych</title>\n<style>\n  body { margin: 0; font: 12px/1.35 ui-monospace, monospace; background: #777; }\n  #status { background: #111; color: #0f0; padding: 3px 6px; white-space: pre; }\n  #row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 4px; }\n  .cell { overflow: hidden; flex: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000; }\n  iframe { border: 0; display: block; transform-origin: 0 0; background: white; }\n</style>\n<div id=\"status\">loading…</div>\n<div id=\"row\"></div>\n<script>\nconst q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);\nconst src = q.get(\"src\"), dark = q.get(\"theme\") === \"dark\", y = +q.get(\"y\") || 0;\nconst widths = [1440, 768, 390];\nconst row = document.getElementById(\"row\");\nconst total = widths.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);\nconst s = (innerWidth - 8 * (widths.length + 1)) / total;\nconst h = Math.floor((innerHeight - 50) / s);\nconst lines = [];\nPromise.all(widths.map(w => new Promise(done => {\n  const cell = document.createElement(\"div\"), frame = document.createElement(\"iframe\");\n  cell.className = \"cell\"; cell.style.width = w * s + \"px\"; cell.style.height = h * s + \"px\";\n  frame.style.width = w + \"px\"; frame.style.height = h + \"px\"; frame.style.transform = `scale(${s})`;\n  frame.addEventListener(\"load\", async () => {\n    const doc = frame.contentDocument, win = frame.contentWindow;\n    if (dark) {\n      doc.documentElement.style.colorScheme = \"dark\";\n      for (const sheet of doc.styleSheets) for (const rule of sheet.cssRules)\n        if (rule.media && /prefers-color-scheme:\\s*dark/.test(rule.media.mediaText)) rule.media.mediaText = \"all\";\n    }\n    await doc.fonts.ready;\n    win.scrollTo(0, y);\n    const loaded = [...doc.fonts].filter(f => f.family.startsWith(\"Atkinson\") && f.status === \"loaded\")\n      .map(f => f.family).join(\"+\");\n    lines.push(`${w}: inner=${win.innerWidth} scrollW=${doc.documentElement.scrollWidth} hscroll=${doc.documentElement.scrollWidth > win.innerWidth} fonts=${loaded || \"NONE\"}`);\n    done();\n  });\n  frame.src = src;\n  cell.append(frame); {"parentUuid":"bbe86222-8b18-4c9a-975a-af2aee2c8c71","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dc99df29-e4b9-4cb1-a895-51f064538db1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since 2789632 — ticket T19 is GitHub issue #23 (spec #22) on DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"d71be1e2-bebe-40b4-8c01-22e2262b1224","timestamp":"2026-10-01T17:57:09.978Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01G5boHFUnK734zT8ZTZesBD","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3cc08e26-1c8f-444e-b94f-d33a66b0f7dc","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The only absolute link is 404.html's `<base href=CMS_BASE_PATH>`. That is an exception to the \"relative paths only\" rule in CLAUDE.md, but ADR-007 documents it and `crawl()` allows only that one `<base>`. Risk, a judgement call: `not_found()` doesn't check `BASE_PATH`. If someone set it to `/repo/` instead of a full URL, it would emit a root-absolute href.\n  - **Security.** The font route is safe from path traversal: `{name}` can't contain `/`, and `asset()` only looks paths up in the `assets()` dict of files it listed itself. `Markup(STYLESHEET.read_text())` only wraps a file from the repo, never user input. Responses send `nosniff`. Nothing here touches CSRF, sanitizing, or drafts. `/admin.css` is served without login, which ADR-007 intends, and the file holds no data.\n  - **No new dependency.** `markupsafe` was already imported in `app/editor.py` and `app/rendering.py`.\n  - **CSS class names.** Every new class has a prefix and follows the repo's existing kind-scope pattern (`header-home`, `nav-site`, `content-body`). There's nothing as generic as `.status` or `.title`, and none of the new classes are used outside `templates/public`.\n  - **No CSS leakage.** The broad selectors in `static/site.css` (`*`, `body`, `a`, `h1, h2, h3`, `:focus-visible`, and `*` under reduced motion) can't reach admin pages. `public/layout.html` stands alone, and `tests/test_t19_look_and_feel.py` checks in both directions that neither side links the other's stylesheet.\n  \n  **Stale comment (the diff made it untrue)**\n  - `app/settings.py:26`: `STATIC = ... # the admin console's scripts, served under its login`. It now also holds the public `site.css` and the fonts, and `admin.css` is served without login.\n  \n  **Smells (all judgement calls)**\n  - **Shotgun Surgery.** Which file types count as assets is decided in two places: `public_site.assets()` filters on `font.suffix in (\".woff2\", \".txt\")`, and `routes/public._ASSET_TYPES` maps `.css/.woff2/.txt`. A new font format means editing both. If they drift apart, `_ASSET_TYPES[stored.suffix]` raises `KeyError` and the request fails with a 500. One shared map would fix it.\n  - **Duplicated Code.** The `.content-body` and `.chart-*` rules now exist in both `site.css` and `admin.css`, so a new class in `chart_drawing.CLASSES` needs edits in two stylesheets. ADR-007 chose this split on purpose, so this is only worth noting.\n  - **Dead rule.** `admin.css` keeps `.nav-site ul { ... }`, but no admin template uses `.nav-site` any more.\n  - **Mysterious Name.** In `_lists.html`, `nav_number(n)` also numbers the section headings through `section_head`, so a name like `index_number` would fit better. `.head-section` puts its words the other way round from `.section-home` and `.section-list`. The three `.*-item` classes (`.title-item`, `.meta-item`, `.body-item`) are vague but don't collide with anything.\n  - **Repeated work.** `site_preview.site_file` calls `public_site.assets()` to test membership, then `asset(path)` calls it again, so the font directory is listed twice per request.\n  - **Tests.** `crawl()` builds the tuple `(\"url\", \"url\", link)` only so stylesheet links fit the HTML-tag shape, and then the code relies on `tag != \"a\"`. That's a little opaque.\n  - **Surrounding idiom.**\n    - The `site_file` docstring line in `app/routes/site_preview.py` (line 24) is 107 characters. The rewrap was missed; the rest of that file wraps at about 79.\n    - Glossary: the 404 copy says \"The page may have been taken down\". Here \"page\" means a web page, not a Report, so it's acceptable. The Report fact labelled \"PDF\" could use the glossary's \"attached file\".\n</agent-message>"}
